description: Known Error / Blocker registry. Register first; solutions are applied and verified, not only noted.

fields.known_solution_id: nullable reference to KNOWN_SOLUTIONS or prior entry
fields.status: OPEN | KNOWN_ERROR | RESEARCHING | REMEDIATING | VERIFIED | RESUMED | HOLD_CONSCIOUS

rules: Every HOLD or failure MUST create or update an entry
If evidence_present is false, research_launched must become true or status RESEARCHING
If a solution is applied, remediation_applied true and verification_result set after verify
Append-only history preferred; corrections are new entries or explicit updates with timestamp
